newsitem.title: RUSSIA: LUKoil says no decision on bond issue.
newsitem.headline: LUKoil says no decision on bond issue.

text.p: Russia's biggest oil company NK LUKoil has made no decision on whether to issue a Eurobond, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
Syndicate managers said on Wednesday that LUKoil was in the process of deciding whether or not to issue a Eurobond and was asking banks for financing ideas.
"We are deciding, we are thinking, but no decision has been taken," spokesman Dmitry Dolgov told Reuters.
He said no mandate had been awarded for any issue.
One syndicate official said on Wednesday LUKoil had awarded the mandate for an international bond issue.
A number of issues are waiting in the wings for Russia's first sovereign Eurobond, expected later this month.
Natural gas monopoly Gazprom GAZP.RTS 0#GAZP.RUO said earlier in November it planned to target foreign investors with an international bond issue.

Privatisation minister Alfred Kokh said last month that a Eurobond convertible into 7.5 percent of the shares of national power company Unified Energy System EESR.RTS 0#EESR.RUO would be issued in December.
